name: textvqa
description: TextVQA: short grounded answers over OCR-heavy natural images.

dataset.subset: seeded sample of 128 (seed=42) after sorting by question_id

note: Pinned protocol: lmms-lab/textvqa validation split, raw dataset question rendered through the target's chat template, images exported byte-identical to the upstream JPEGs, greedy decoding, max_new_tokens=32, sequential verification. Per-row question/image hashes are recorded in benchmarks/prompts/textvqa_v1.jsonl; the export is reproducible from the pinned shard hashes with the same seed.
